title: Observation
description: Original automated or manual observation (technical specification 'Original observation' row). Originals are immutable: corrections append revisions, they never overwrite. Observation time (observedAt, a UTC instant) and ingestion time (receivedAt) are distinct from the first release. sourceOffset preserves the source-local UTC offset at capture so DST transitions remain reconstructible. A null value is a reported-but-empty reading and is NOT zero; a missing reading is represented by the absence of an observation plus a declared gap.

logicalKey.description: Composite logical key (stream + observed instant) used by revision and history endpoints. Duplicate source events may share a logical key with distinct ids.

observedAt.description: UTC instant the phenomenon was observed (RFC 3339, Z).

sourceOffset.description: Source-local UTC offset at capture, e.g. -07:00 (MST) or -06:00 (MDT).

value.description: Source value in unitId. Null means reported no-value; zero means zero; both occur in fixtures.

unitId.description: Governed unit identifier (source units are preserved).

valueType.description: Observed versus estimated is preserved end-to-end and never silently converted.

processingLevel.description: Level of THIS record. Originals enter as raw; revisions carry later levels.

sourceEventId.description: Provider event identifier; unique within a stream. Retransmissions produce a new event id and may duplicate an instant.

receivedAt.description: UTC instant the backend accepted the record. Late arrivals have receivedAt far after observedAt.
